## Households

Run the personal lifestyle audit: map how your consumption, housing, transportation, and giving actually land on your community's most vulnerable. Take up a 30-day "justice in practice" challenge of incremental changes — ethical purchasing, one advocacy act, one relationship across an economic boundary. Review your digital footprint by the same standard, and study ethical stewardship of family finances as discipleship, not decoration.
